project_type: React 19.2.0 + Vite 7.3.1 + Supabase 2.104.1 PWA (Progressive Web App)
build_system: Vite with esbuild minification, Tailwind CSS 4.2.4 via @tailwindcss/vite plugin
test_framework: None detected - manual testing required with Lighthouse and browser DevTools
test_command: npm run dev (manual testing), Lighthouse audit via npm run preview
verification_instructions: 1. Run 'npm run build' (must succeed with 0 errors). 2. Run 'npm run dev' and test admin dashboard all tabs load. 3. Open DevTools Network tab, verify paginated queries with .range() params. 4. Verify React DevTools Profiler shows memo'd components not re-rendering unnecessarily. 5. Run 'npm run build && npm run preview', then Lighthouse audit targeting Performance 85+, FCP <1.5s, LCP <2.5s. 6. Execute PERFORMANCE_DATABASE_INDEXES.sql in Supabase SQL Editor and verify indexes exist with the monitoring query included in the file.
snapshot_or_generated_files: dist/ folder generated by 'npm run build'. No files checked into git from build output.
environment_constraints: Supabase project URL in .env as VITE_SUPABASE_URL and VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY. React Query and react-intersection-observer NOT currently installed. No hooks/ directory exists yet. Dev server runs on localhost:5173 via 'npm run dev --host'.
contribution_requirements: Per AGENTS.md: Autonomous execution without asking permission. No confirmation prompts. Execute commands directly and report results.
key_patterns: Supabase queries use .from('table').select('*, related_table(columns)') for joins. AdminDashboard.jsx uses motion.div with tabVariants for tab switching. Components use inline styles extensively with theme colors from getTheme() utility. ReportCard.jsx already uses icon-based UI (lucide-react) with minimal tags. MapPins.jsx exports PinMarker as functional component. ElNinoMonitoringDashboard.jsx is large monolithic component fetching data via useEffect with Promise.all for multiple tables.
directory_structure: src/ contains: components/ (dashboard/, layout/, map/, ui/, ui/report/), context/ (ThemeContext.jsx), lib/ (supabase.js), screens/ (AdminDashboard.jsx, HomeScreen.jsx, MapScreen.jsx, AdminMapScreen.jsx, ProfileScreen.jsx), services/ (kloudtechService.js). Root has index.html, vite.config.js, package.json, multiple .sql schema files. No hooks/ directory exists yet.
